Getting started by customising my Voat account

How do view my blocked subverses and manage them?

There is currently no mechanism for this, but it is a highly requested feature.

How do I view posts I have saved?

Head to account overview (click your name in the userblock) and go to the saved tab.

Can I use multiple accounts and easily switch between them?

Accounts are currently limited to one per-IP, so to have more you are gonna have to get a bit creative (i.e. use a VPN or Tor). There is no easy switch mechanism. Log in and out and use a password manager.

You are able to upvote your own comment, if just like you already upvoted your own created topic then why is comments not the same?

Posts start at +1 and comments at 0. SCP is basically worthless on this site, so you don't gain anything from that starting point.

Nightmode

The lightbulb in the userblock toggles nightmode. However, some subverses with legacy stylesheets (e.g. Typogra 2.0) may not have a nightmode. It should work on the majority of subs, though.

Check out /v/AVE for a RES-like extension that adds some nice features (user blocking, domain blocking, user tagging, domain tagging, etc.). You can find more useful information in our sidebar, along with some neat subverses to check out.
